message: Fixes false active-license shutdown caused by browser/session binding assumptions. The protected core supports Opera and other Chromium-family app-mode browsers, so the watchdog now discovers any process carrying the localhost --app URL instead of filtering to Chrome/Edge/Brave. The exact core /api/status endpoint is retried continuously, installed-license parsing remains a fallback, and an identity-discovery delay no longer closes an otherwise valid activated session. Once License ID or Hardware ID is bound, the signed revocation bundle is still checked every 2 seconds and confirmed revoked/deleted access is terminated immediately. Hardware-level blocking, duplicate-key protection, startup preflight, and signed single-file revocation bundles remain enabled.
